_source: First competitive map. Built against the §37 per-map tests (design/07-maps.md) and the terrain rules in data/terrain.json. Verified by scripts/map-check.mjs.
name: Twin Ridge
_symmetryNote: Every element has a counterpart at rot(x,y) = (128-x, 128-y); central elements are self-symmetric. This makes all travel-time and resource tests exact by construction (§37).
tileScale: 1 tile ≈ 4 m; ranges in data/units are in these tiles.
style: moderate choke-point + multi-route (design/07 §38 pool slot). Low-ground bases, a central narrow throat overlooked by two high-ground ridges, and two wide flank lanes around it.

resources.note: p1 wood floor — safe, renewable, near-base (§04)
p1 natural-expansion ore — the affordable ceiling, semi-exposed
central rich ore, west of the throat — the map's prize
central rich ore, east of the throat (rot pair)

highGround.note: hold it to first-strike the central throat; artillery position (§37)

chokes.note: direct route; narrow, cliff-walled, overlooked by both ridges — splash/first-strike terrain (§37)
wide NW flank — mobility/vehicle route around the throat, with forest cover

barriers.note: south face of north-ridge (impassable except ramp)
NW pool — channels the flank; air/amphibious only

forests.note: infantry cover/concealment on the NW flank (combat-rules forestConcealment)

neutralObjectives.note: capturing reveals the central contest — rewards map control, counters stealth pushes (§28)

airspace: open — aircraft and climb/jump units cross the ridges freely, bypassing the ground throat (terrain.json highGround.access)

designTests._note: Mirrors terrain.json perMapTestHooks + design/07 §37; asserted by map-check.mjs.
designTests.resourceEquality: each player: 1 wood + 1 natural ore; central rich ore is a symmetric contested pair
designTests.flankAroundEveryNarrowChoke: throat (narrow) is flanked by nw-pass and se-pass (wide)
designTests.everyPlateauHasARamp: north-ridge and south-ridge each have a ground ramp
designTests.elevatedArtilleryCannotHitBaseFromSafety: min ridge→base distance ≈ 45 tiles ≫ artillery range 9
